Colorado ranks #7 of 51 tracked states (88th percentile) with 765 verified live revenue-role openings across 152 employers. State-average hiring aggressiveness is 71/100 with a active tier skew (48% of roles).

The market tilts toward Adjacent Revenue Roles (22% of reqs) concentrated in Remote-first (91%). Denver: collaborative, outdoorsy, work-life balance prioritized, fast-growing startup energy. Boulder: innovative, highly educated, progressive. Colorado Springs: more conservative, defense/military community-centric. All hubs strong on hybrid models.

Palantir (Denver HQ), Ping Identity, Zayo, Rally Software, DaVita tech, hundreds of funded startups.
